title: Christian pulpit
subtitle: Sermons for preaching and group study

content:
(Luke 2:10, 11)
Man has always been a being eager for
news. “To hear and say a new thing” (Acts
17:21) was already a favorite occupation of the Athenians
in the time of Saint Paul. The main reason is given
from this fact that man is a being by nature curious and, generally, dissatisfied; always
expects something new that will benefit him or improve his condition, although many times the same thing happens.
contrary.
There is good and bad news, expected and unexpected, and some, although highly anticipated, their arrival
surprises those who long for them most. Such was the case of
warning that the young Rode gave to the disciples who
They were praying in favor of Saint Peter, and of the same
character was that which the angels gave to the shepherds
in Bethlehem. Although they undoubtedly expected it, yes
were pious Jews (see Luke 2:25 and 38), they
surprised in such a way that they could not believe what
they saw The news was so big!
Let us notice seven reasons for greatness in this great
news:
17
1. It is great because of the way it was
    proclaimed
Big news is usually announced
a way appropriate to its importance. By radio,
press, posters, etc. But the most transcendental news for the human race would have remained ignored if the heavens had not opened to proclaim it to the shepherds of Bethlehem. If the earth did not pay attention
of the great event in the heavens had a lot
importance. The Word of God wearing human flesh, made in the likeness of men, was a
wonder of divine love. Saint Peter was right
to declare that God's purposes for men
Believers cause the admiration of the angels themselves (1 Peter 1:12). Only those who are at
another side of the tangible and transitory can appreciate
things in their true value, because they see everything
in the light of eternity. Do we appreciate what
Do angels appreciate?
2. Due to his personal character
Most of the news in which we are interested does not affect us at all and we forget it almost as soon as we see our satisfaction.
curiosity. But this has a personal character,
same for the shepherds who heard it for the first
time as for anyone else who can hear it
through the centuries: "It is born unto you." of any
18
Another person would simply say: "He has been born." The
reason is that no one is born in favor of others like
Christ was born. Can you say that Christ was born for you?
How happy the soul is that when remembering this Christmas
the glorious birth can say: In Bethlehem of Judea
Twenty centuries ago a Savior was born to me! (See anecdote The Gift of Christmas.)
3. For being the fulfillment of a great promise
The phrase "in the city of David" refers to it.
God never forgets what he promises. I had promised
a King to Israel from the line of David (Isaiah 11:1 who
was to be at the same time Redeemer (comp. Isaiah
52:13 with the context that follows chap. 53). And how admirably it was fulfilled in the coming, life and death of Jesus! The fulfillment of God's words
in the past and present with respect to the people
chosen, Israel, is a guarantee that he will fulfill everything
what he has promised us in Jesus Christ. The current
tragedy of the Jews (Zechariah 13:8, 9, and Luke
21:24) is a great reason for confidence for the people
Christian. (See anecdote A blunt demonstration.)
4. By the person referred to
The shepherds expected a great Messiah, but no
as great as "Christ the Lord" was announced to them
anointed and King, not of Israel, but of the world and
of the entire universe. How I had to admire them!
19
contrast between the angel's proclamation and the humble reality of the manger. Christ the Lord among the
straws; not in a dwelling, the most humble, of the
human beings, but in the habitation of beasts. Good
The prophet had said: "Despised and rejected
among men” (Isaiah 53:3). But his greatness
It was of its own right and did not consist of externalities. Only this is true greatness. (See
anecdote The Brahman and Stanley Jones. )His moral greatness stands out more because, being
Lord became a servant for love of us; being
great became humble to elevate us to his greatness.
5. For the reason of his coming
"A Savior is born to you"; not a teacher or
example as some claim. This is the title
greatest of his coats of arms, the highest of his offices, the
highest of its prerogatives. The mission of
Christ would have been very poor, compared to what he is,
If only he had come to give us good advice. The
world had already had great advisors, but
I had never had a Savior. Buddha, Confucius,
Socrates and Plato had said everything best that the
men can say and hear; but none were
stated: "Come to me, all you who are labored and burdened, and I will give you rest." «I give them life
eternal", "He who believes in Me, even though he is dead
will live," and this is precisely what the
world: a Savior willing to redeem, to put himself
20
instead of sinners; a Savior to raise
to the most fallen, infusing them with new life. Not a
great ideal, but a great power. No man has
been delivered from his sins by invoking the great
masters of Humanity, but millions have
been invoking the sacred name of Jesus; turning to God through his mediation. Well they said
apostles before the enraged Sanhedrin: "In no case
another there is salvation because there is no other name under heaven given among men in which we can
be saved."
6. For the feeling intended to produce
"News of great joy." Joy is caused by certain long-awaited news. An amnesty, termination
of a war, etc.; but there is no joy like that
produces in the soul the good news of the love of God
revealed in the manger of Bethlehem. There is no news
better. Therefore the highest and most sublime joy is
the characteristic of all genuine Christianity
(Philippians 4:4). A faith without joy is a dead faith or
sickly We must look for the cause of the lack of
joy in the Christian soul and repair it without delay,
because "the joy of the Lord is our strength," to the
time an occasion of testimony and honor for
the faith we profess. Holiness does not consist of
long faces. There is nothing wrong with the joy of Christmas, but let it be for the real reason. Ezra
and Paul say, “rejoice” (Nehemiah 8:10; Philippians
21
4:4). (See anecdotes The reason for Haydn and Died
smiling.)
7. Due to its extensive scope
"Which will be for all the people." The joy of
Christmas was not only for the privileged
who received direct revelation from God, but
for all the people. Any news that affects any
way to many it becomes important just for this
reason, especially when it is joy and happiness
destined to produce in those many. salvation
from God is the best of news and it is for the greatest
number of human beings.
But for everyone to be happy it is necessary for everyone to know it. It seems that the angel's warning was well understood by the shepherds,
who began to spread the good news (v.
20) undoubtedly attracting other worshipers to the manger
and other favorers of the sacred family, which
perhaps for this reason we no longer find in the miserable
stable when the Magi visit.
Surely these would do no less within their
half in the distant homeland. It is quite possible that your
testimony contributed to the triumph of the Gospel among
the births and means that are mentioned on the day of
Pentecost (Acts 2:9), since the extension of the
good news in the East acquired such importance
that in a few years he would demand the presence of his own
apostle Saint Peter (1st Peter 5:13).
22
The great news has also come to us through
the mercy of God. Have we given it the importance it deserves? Have we received it for life
eternal and we are spreading it to others? Today the
fact of Christmas is no news, but the
meaning yes. Let us be followers of the glorious
mission that the angels began in Bethlehem.
ANECDOTES
THE GIFT OF CHRISTMASA friend interested in the salvation of another person,
sent him a Bible by mail, which arrived precisely
on Christmas Day itself.
The first text that his eyes read was: «You will call his
name Jesus, because He will save his people from their sins.
A few hours later, he called his
friend and told him:
–My dear friend, I have received the gift of Christmas.
–Ah, I'm glad it wasn't lost! With so much
agglomeration of packages, I was afraid –answered the other.
—No, my dear friend. I told you that I have received
the gift of Christmas, that is, Jesus in my heart.
A CUTTING DEMONSTRATION
The satirical King Frederick I, a friend of Voltaire, asked
on one occasion to the pastor who served as chaplain
in his court:
23
–I would like a clear and forceful demonstration of
that God is God and the Bible is his Word, but I want it
concise and forceful; you already know that I am a man of few
words.
–If Your Majesty allows it, I will give it to you in a single
word.
-Bravo! –said the king ironically–. Say this word.
–The Jews –was the pastor's response.
The king, who knew the history of this town well,
He walked away meditatively.
THE BRAHMAN AND STANLEY JONES
Dr. Stanley Jones says:
«On one occasion, while waiting for a train in
India, I asked an Indian gentleman if he would take the
train that was about to arrive. He answered no, because
There was only one in the third class cars. I told him that I
I would take it.
"Of course," he replied. You can do it because
He is a Christian. If you travel in 1st class that does not exalt you, and if
going in 3rd does not degrade it. You are above these
distinctions, but I have to respect them, because I am a
Brahman.
»If I could have given free rein to my impulses
– continues Dr. Jones – he would have danced on the platform.
The 1st class does not exalt, the 3rd does not humiliate, joy does not
makes us lose our minds, nor does grief break our hearts,
when we are truly Christians and do not live
of appearances.
24
HADYN'S REASON
Someone asked Hadyn why she was always so
their religious music is joyful.
"It's just that when I start to think," he explained,
famous musician – in what God is, what he has done and what
What he intends to do with his redeemed people, including me
myself, I cannot help but be happy, and the
joy of the heart jumps to the notes.
HE DIED SMILING
A graceful 16-year-old girl, who had been converted from Mohammedanism and lived a magnificent life
Christian before her parents, she fell ill and died. some time
Later, the mother came to the missionaries' house and told them
She asked what strange medicine they had given her daughter.
The missionary responded a little scared that the
blamed for his death:
–No, we didn't give him anything.
–Oh, yes! –the mother insisted–. Our daughter died smiling. People of our religion don't die from this
way.
25

lessons.title: Poor while rich
lessons.subtitle: Sermon II
lessons.summary: (2nd Corinthians 8:9) Since humanity began to spread over the earth, the great controversy between the poor and the rich was established, those who have less envying those who have more; These often despise and exploit the poor in order to be richer. And in the coming and going of life and generations, one of these three things has happened in the social field: poor people who have become rich because fortune has quickly favored them; rich people who have fallen into poverty because…
content:
(2nd Corinthians 8:9)
Since humanity began to spread
On earth, the great controversy was established between the poor and the rich, those who have less envying those who have more; these despising
many times and exploiting the poor in order
to be richer.
And in the coming and going of life and generations
has occurred, in the social field, any of these three
things: poor people who have become rich because fortune has quickly favored them; rich people who have fallen into poverty for inverse reasons, and also
rich people who have helped poor people rise
social level. But it has never happened, on the ground
human, the event that is expressed in our text:
A rich man voluntarily becomes poor to enrich himself
with their poverty to many helpless of the poorest
condition.
Yet this is the meaning of Christmas
and of the entire Gospel. It has been said that Christmas
It is the Gospel in miniature, and it is wonderful.
Suppose you found this text in a book
26
profane, with the name substituted. you couldn't believe
the unlikely story; However, it was to a degree
superlative in the case of the coming of Christ to the
world. Let us reverently consider this portentous event, using a little our imagination.
In the event of Christmas, they stand out
three wonders:
1. The wealth of Christ
Who is he who was born so humbly in the
Bethlehem manger? (John 1:14 and Colossians 1:15-17).
«The Word»; «the image of the invisible God; "the firstborn of every creature." Not because it was a creature, since it existed from all eternity in
the bosom of the Father as an integral part of the Divinity, in potency and essence, but for being the
Life itself; the cause and reason for the existence of
all creatures.
Among these are, first of all, the
angels. How beautiful and powerful they are! These wonderful beings were able to realize their existence (a faculty that we also have, but not
animals) and no doubt they began to wonder
the reason for their existence and to worship their Creator.
The Divine Spirit did another wonderful thing;
created and set in motion the invisible universal ether
(Hebrews 11:3); organized matter, atoms,
dust of the Universe; and of them the worlds. We do not know how many millions of centuries have passed,
27
Well, the Bible doesn't say it. Science tries to investigate the age of matter and assures that it can
know Matter is not eternal, because from nothing
nothing can come out.
On this little planet called Earth there appeared
life by the power of the Spirit of God that moved over the surface of the waters. plant life; after
animal life, fish, birds, quadrupeds. What did the Creator intend? Create a being of static matter,
suitable to serve as a dwelling place for a spirit. The spirit,
linked to the matter, which he would use as an instrument.
Animals had existed for millions of years without
having done nothing of themselves or by themselves; but that one
being extraordinary, of matter and spirit, would collaborate
with God to make this whole globe a great
paradise. God would reveal the laws of matter to him
and man would build wonderful things: buildings,
roads, machines, instruments suitable for
provide yourself with a more pleasant and easier life. By
Of course, this being of matter and spirit, knowing
of himself and the passage of time, he would not have to
die... It would fill the earth with happy beings who would enjoy all the wonders of creation until
unsuspected limits.
We can imagine that the celestial beings wanted to know the cause of so many wonders until
that what Hebrews 1 describes happened: "The Word of
God, who existed with the Father from Eternity, the
only begotten Son, was made known to the angels, and
He was adored and exalted by all created beings.
28
Everyone recognized that he was a Unique Being with whom
They couldn't be compared. For this reason he was praised by all
creation. He was immensely rich, but not in the sensehuman, limited and temporary, but in the most
real and absolute.
He was rich in power…His will was law, and he had
millions of beings willing to fulfill it.
He was rich in possessions… In graphic language
Hebrew we read: "Ask of me and I will give you as your possession."
the ends of the earth” (more literally, of the Cosmos, that is, of the Universe) (Psalm 2:8). Theirs were
all the precious materials… Each star is yours…
He was rich in love..., because he was loved by the Father,
of the Holy Spirit and the angels…
He was rich in glory... They did not stop praising him and
worship him all orders of creatures, angels,
archangels, cherubs, seraphim. All the inhabitants of the Universe addressed him the songs of Revelation 4:11 and 5:13.
2. His humiliation
a) The reason.
One of the angels rebelled against God and his
visible representative by which the
heavens and earth (Colossians 1:18). He did not know how to appreciate
the difference between him, a created being, and the Only Begotten
of the Father, an uncreated Being. As he was the most beautiful,
elevated and luminous of the angels, Lucifer believed that
29
must be the sole representative of the Creator and must
receive worship. When he failed in his impious attempt, and was banished, he came to this world, which ended
to reach the proper state to house living beings
intelligent, and in which God had done this thing
new (putting a spiritual being inside a material envelope) and… we all know the story:
He miserably deceived the first inhabitants
of the world, persuading them to disobey God.
He gave them the first thoughts of distrust. Sin, ruin,
death.
Then the plan that the Almighty had planned from eternity was revealed: From the seed
from the woman would come One who would take human flesh... a glorious Being who would undo the work of the evil one, suffering for sinners... Who would it be?
b) The immensity of his humiliation,
   view from above
We can imagine the angels intrigued by
the announcement of the divine plan; of Redemption. Let's imagine a conversation between Miguel and Gabriel:
–Hey, you, captain of the hosts of the Lord, have you
heard the purpose of the Eternal? Who will he send? To
you or me?
–Brother archangel –the person questioned would respond–,
I will never say no, if the Almighty ordered me to. But do you know what it is to be tied to the
matter..., let the mag30 force hold you by your feet
netics of the cosmos, and you have to move them to get from one place to another? Have you seen how they travel
ridiculous distances for beings of matter... and how
do they get tired and suffer? Furthermore, the promised Messiah will have to suffer, not only the inconveniences of being
tied to a material body, but much more. Have you
Have you heard what God has said to the evil deceiver?:
"You will strike his heel." we don't know
what it is to suffer..., to be hurt, to die...; but i have
seen when one animal devours another. Did you see what
What did Abel suffer when Cain wounded him…? And when
millions of men be like Cain, so
mean, so selfish, so lacking in love, it will be terrible
for the poor celestial being who has to go to such a
world…!
We can imagine that one day it spread in the
heavens the great news:
–Do you know who goes to earth to redeem men? None other than the Only Begotten! The Word of
God!
–Is it possible? And will he become a man? Will it be like
one of them? Will it not appear on the earth as a
theophany and will disappear when it pleases?
-No no! That is to be born, take true
human flesh; be a man and die for men.
Such is the mysterious and sublime divine plan!
c) The reasons for his deep humiliation
We can continue imagining the conversation
angelica:
31
–And where will the Messiah of God, the
Redeemer? It would be great if I were born in one of
the palaces of India, or in the court of
Rome. There is a very great emperor there,
Octavius Caesar, who has dominated twenty nations, and
It's good.
-Well? –would another angelic being interrupt?– Ask your guardian angel. And the empress? To theAfter all, he should be her child, not his. There is
more dirt in his heart, pride, vanity, despotism... Do you know how he treats slaves?
–In addition, when his redeeming death occurred, they would attribute a political character to it; it wouldn't seem
a voluntary offering of love. On the other hand,
You know that kings are surrounded by proud rich people, and they do not approach the people.
–In Athens there are some very wise men, the
philosophers –another angel would burst in–. Wouldn't it be there
most suitable place?
-No way. Your teaching would be confused
with that of those teachers; would be attributed to wisdom
human. And these same men, do you know how they treat the townspeople? To your neighbors? They
They call commoners, they reject the ignorant...
We can imagine another angelic being interrupting:
–You have forgotten one thing, brothers! for
Why did God bring Israel out of Egypt and do so many wonders? Here are the prophecies! The Holy Spirit
You are not wrong! The Messiah must be a descendant
32
of David and will be born in Bethlehem (Micah 5:1). It's already leaving
approaching time.
–But there is no king in Israel! If they dominate
Romans! How many years will it take before
that the descendants of David will be back in
the throne and can provide a worthy home for the Messiah
prince?
We can imagine, finally, Gabriel coming joyfully to the angelic court to tell them:
–I already know where the Messiah will be born! The Eternal has
commissioned to carry the message!
–To whom? Where?
–To María, a maiden daughter of Joaquín and granddaughter
of Eli. She is an excellent young lady, who lives in
Nazareth... If you had seen the horror that took
when you see me!
d) The lesson of his humility
We could still imagine another scene of joy
among the celestial beings on that memorable night when the angels sang "Glory to God in the
heights!" This is the place – the celestial beings would say
admired before the manger – open to everyone;
There are no lackeys or soldiers here. How humble and
poor, but how right! Here you can all go
kind of people And what a lesson it will be for the rich
proud, through the centuries, that to celebrate
the ineffable event have to prepare some
rough branches and some straws to contrast with
its luxury and its pride! How wise is our God!
33
This is the Christmas story seen from
up. Paul describes the great mystery with these
sober words: «God, the fulfillment of the
time he sent his Son made of a woman..." Choosing a humble, pure, docile maiden, he prepared the
Verb a body without sin. So he who was great,
became small; he who was rich became poor; the one who
He was glorious, he was humble.
Poor at birth, in a miserable stable.
Poor in his life. The one who was the absolute owner of
heavenly riches, he had to tell an alleged
follower (Matthew 10:20 and Luke 9:58).
How many times would I suffer fatigue! (John 4:1).
He suffered hunger (Matthew 21:19; Mark 11:13).
He knew what sadness was (John 11:35).
He experienced pain, to the point of deserving
the adjective “Man of Sorrows”; he humiliated himself (or
became poor) to the uttermost.
3. Enriched by their poverty
The last part of our text declares the
reason and result of such a transcendental change:
Enrich many: So that with their poverty we might be
we enriched. Enrich another with property
own is nothing special, but doing it with
(or through) poverty is implausible. But that's how it was
necessary. God could not enrich spiritually
to sinful beings; It would have been immoral and harmful.
Put money and power in the hands of a man
34
perverse What will be the result? It was essential
to enrich his people, that the divine Messiah
will take away sin; met the requirements of the
justice and transform the feelings of men through his love. He did this with his humiliation, because of his poverty. (See the anecdote The
sacrifice of the millionaire lady.)
In this way we are enriched:1) For the forgiveness of our moral debts;
because debts are our sins, debts to the
holiness of God, this is how Jesus expresses it in the
Our Father. You cannot make a person rich
without paying the debts...
2) Adopting us as children (Ephesians 1:3-5 and
11:12; John 1:12 and 1 John 3:1-5). (See anecdote By
love of Carlos.)
3) Making us joint heirs with Christ (Romans
8:17 and 1 Corinthians 3:21).
That is why we feel so united to the child of Bethlehem;
His glory is ours; His life is ours. How
Should we reciprocate? Have you understood the meaning of Christmas? Do you live in the spirit of
Christmas? Don't you want to reciprocate better?
35
ANECDOTES
THE SACRIFICE OF THE MISS MILLIONAIRE
An American lady, a Christian, came to meet
inheritance in possession of a large fortune that he wanted
manage herself for charitable purposes.
For this purpose, it was proposed to approach the poor to
meet them; but feeling that his riches were a
impediment, he placed his entire fortune in the bank in such a way
so that she herself could not get anything within a year.
He rented a home in one of the most
humble and worked to earn their living. This is how it worked
many relationships and was sometimes helped by her
own neighbors who pitied their apparent helplessness. In this way he came to know experimentally the
hardships of poverty and learned to distinguish between
worthy needy and the professionally lazy.
Eagerly waiting for the moment to be able to express
his true condition and thus he was able to lift and help
many when the time was up. The same poor
They felt a sacred respect for that woman who was so
way he had sacrificed himself, and they were trying to prevent anyone
abuse her kindness so that she could fulfill her
purposes in the most effective way.
Our Lord became poor being rich for love of
us. Will we not try to be your servants and collaborators in the most loyal way?
36
FOR THE LOVE OF CARLOS
A homeless boy who used to sleep in the
Thames sheds when it was not convenient for him to do so
in the Salvation Army night shelters,
He enlisted in the British Army during the First War
World Cup, where he became a close friend of another young man from
distinguished position, called Carlos. Their friendship became
so deep, that they seemed like real brothers.
In the heat of battle, Charles fell to his death.
injured and his friend rushed to treat him, while
He was waiting for the arrival of the army stretcher bearers.
Carlos, feeling that his end was approaching, said to his
friend:
–I am not afraid to die because Christ has saved me, but
I'm so sorry for you. I had such good plans for
when we were both discharged from the army…!
Suddenly he said:
–Open my backpack and give me one of my cards. Still
We have time for it.
Taking the card, he wrote with a trembling hand:
«Parents: goodbye from your son. The bearer is my
friend Enrique. My last wish is that you welcome him home
as if it were myself. Do it, for the love of Carlos.
Carlos, indeed, died after a short
hospital stay. His weak constitution could not
resist blood loss. But Enrique managed to return.
Upon being discharged he went to the home of his good friend and
He spoke to the grieving parents, who could not get enough of
ask him about his beloved son. Enrique did not dare
but give the card, undecided about the reaction of the
his friend's parents, but he finally did it. The parents
37
They sobbed at this new proof of their son's magnanimous heart, and with the best will they welcomed the young man.
vagabond without family or home, adopting him as a son
own out of love for his son Carlos.
Saint Paul says: "He made us accepted in the Beloved"
(Ephesians 1:6).
38

lessons.title: Daily things
lessons.subtitle: Sermon III
lessons.summary: Every time, at the beginning of the new year, good resolutions are usually made, but a year is too long for the inconstancy of the human character. In the same way that a church will not be more fervent than the group of its members, nor will a nation be richer than the sum of the wealth of its citizens, the year will be neither more nor less than the group of days that compose it. That's why Scripture places so much emphasis on daily things. Let us notice nine daily things in the Holy Scriptures: 1.…
content:
Every time, at the beginning of the new year, good resolutions are usually made, but a year is very long.
for the inconstancy of human character. of the same
so a church will not be more fervent than it
that they be the group of its members, nor a nation
will be richer than the sum of the riches of her
citizens, the year will be neither more nor less than the
set of days that compose it. Hence the
Scripture places so much emphasis on everyday things. Let us notice nine daily things in the Holy Scriptures:
1. Daily prayer
"I have called you, O Lord, daily" (Psalm 88:9).
It is impossible to live a normal Christian life without
the practice of daily prayer. That great man
of business, prime minister of the Persian empire, who
His name was Daniel, he felt the imperative need to
climb the stairs of his palace every day to his
prayer chamber, and this not once, but three times a
day. The forgetfulness of this Christian duty has been the cause
of many falls, and its practice, the secret of mu39
Chas powerful lives. It is advisable, however, to avoid
routine in the performance of this Christian duty. By
This is good to prepare the spirit with some reading
pious that encourages us to pray. It is convenient that we have something to say to God that comes from the depths of the
heart, before opening our lips before Him.
2. Daily Bible reading
"They searched the Scriptures every day whether these things
They were like that” (Acts 17:11).
Such is the noble example of the Berean Christians.

(Matthew 27:22)
Never has a more important question been
formulated by human lips.

content:
THE RESURRECTION OF THE LORD
(1 Corinthians 15:1-22)
How glorious it is for the believer who after the
consideration of the death of Christ that is done in
These days, we can talk about his resurrection! Suppose he had not been resurrected. For centuries, the
humanity would have been wondering:
Could it be true that He was the Messiah? Is it true or
the message of Christianity is not. (See the anecdote The Name Changed.)
1. The certainty of the resurrection
The apostle Paul, after an exposition by
the argument called reductio ad absurdum,
about the uselessness and ineffectiveness of our faith if Christ
had not been resurrected, he exclaims triumphantly: "But
now, Christ has risen from the dead. there is no
any uncertainty. That witness, formerly enemy and
persecutor of the Christian faith, had reasons to
know it. (See the anecdote A New Epitaph.)
Behind him, they must also have good reasons
to affirm it those who during the first three
89
centuries they allowed themselves to be tormented and take their lives to
support such a statement. Paul names for
order in this chapter to those who saw him in ten
different occasions, individually or in groups
up to five hundred. Other witnesses relate the words and even the actions of the resurrected Savior.
There are only three assumptions here:
a) Or hundreds of people let themselves be killed by
what they knew was false.
b) Or they all became insane at once.
c) Or Christ was “truly” resurrected (Luke
24:34).
What is preferable to believe? Undoubtedly, that
He resurrected.
2. Meaning of the resurrection
“Firstfruits of those who slept,” says the apostle.
But were there not others resurrected by the prophets and by
Christ himself? Yes, but they were all deferred from the
death, not delivered from it. They all died again.
Only Christ was the definitive victor, and this is why
himself, without outside help. His resurrection for
Immortality was a totally new thing in the
human history; hence its great importance. In
effect, if He had not risen:
a) There would be no guarantee for us that it would be
the Son of God, the promised Redeemer. The sign of
miracles were not enough. Other prophets made them
too.
90
b) There would be no guarantee that God accepted the
rescue. No evidence of salvation would exist
for us.
c) Nor could we trust in the fulfillment of his great promises (John 14:2 and 23;
16:24-27; 17:24 and many others would be beautiful words
without security).
I wish it were true! –we would exclaim– that this
good man of God, who died so many years ago,
May he be in glory and be able to fulfill everything he said.
But now "Christ is risen!" Has fulfilled the
great sign that he gave to the Jews (John 2:18-22). It will do everything else. (See the anecdote An epitaph
original.)
3. Consequences of the resurrection
“All in Christ will be made alive” (v. 22). The
greatest of Christ's claims is that of
that He was Life. May he be a Pastor, Friend and,
even in a figurative sense, the Door, the Way, the
True, it is understandable; but Life, who can
dare to say such? If we still don't know the secret
of this mysterious element that has done so many wonders
produced and is producing around us.
But if the man Christ Jesus controls life, if
dominates, his statement is not incredible. The one who is and
He possesses life, he can give it to whoever he pleases. The one who
was powerful to fulfill his declaration "I have
power to put it and I have power to put it back
91
taking” (John 10:18) can also bring about:
"He who believes in Me, even though he is dead, will live, and the
"Whoever lives and believes in Me will not die forever."
It can give eternal happiness to the soul and provide it with
a new glorified body when it appears in your
glorious coming. Does it not give a new body every
years to seeds that are dry and inert in appearance?
Nothing is impossible for Him. (See the anecdote Lo
better has left.)
Our situation as beings has been compared
mortals to that of poor shipwrecked people in the middle of the seaenraged We barely hold the fragile
basket of our life with all kinds of efforts
and precautions for a limited time that cannot be prolonged for long. But in the midst of the darkness a beacon of hope has emerged: the resurrection
of Christ that illuminates his glorious promises. (See the anecdote Not so sad for them.) In them you can
anchor the soul, sure that we will not see each other
disappointed. Let us turn to Him without delay and we will have the light of life (John 8:12).
ANECDOTES
THE NAME CHANGED
Dr. A. T. Pierson, preaching at the funeral of
Pastor Gordon, noted that since the resurrection of
Jesus, the apostles rarely used the word "death"
te" to express the end of a believer's life, but
"sleep" or "depart to be with the Lord." That is, in
reality, the death of the Christian.
A NEW EPITAPH
Pastor Gould points out to us that in all
epitaphs we read phrases like these: "Here are the remains", "Here he rests", etc., but how different is the epitaph on the tomb of Jesus! It is not written in gold nor
engraved in stone, but is expressed through the mouth of a
angel, being exactly the opposite of the other tombs:
"It's not here."
AN ORIGINAL EPITAPH
Thomas Spurgeon tells us that he saw an epitaph
which bore these simple words: "Federico", and below,
"Yes, Father, I go," referring to God's call to the
young man whose remains lay there.
THE BEST HAS BEEN GONE
A little boy was excited about a nest of
birds that formed in the garden of his house. He enjoyed
in caressing the eggs so fine and beautiful. After
a few weeks away at relatives' house,
He returned to visit the nest accompanied by his older brother, finding the beautiful eggs broken into pieces.
-What a pity! –he exclaimed sobbing–. They have been thrown
to lose.
93
"Don't say such a thing," replied his brother. have not been
spoiled. The best of them has come out; has wings
and flies.
That's how it is with death. The damaged body is the
egg shell. The best is not there.
NOT SO SAD FOR THEM
As the funeral of a child, the son of a missionary, passed,
two Korean women commented:
–How sad, how sad for these parents! As beautiful as it was!
"Yes," replied the other woman. It is indeed very sad;
but not so much for them as for us, because they,
Christians have a secret that gives them security
that they will get their children back one day, while
We don't know that we can never again
see our own when they die.
94

lessons.summary: (Genesis 2:15-24; Ephesians 5:21-33) Introduction It is customary for evangelicals to consider, on occasions like this, marriage in the light of the Word of God. According to the Bible, marriage constitutes the indissoluble union of two beings who associate to help each other and promote the happiness of each other in all aspects. (Genesis 2:15-24; Ephesians 5:21-33)
Introduction
It is the custom of evangelicals to consider, in
occasions like this one, marriage in the light
of the Word of God. According to the Bible, marriage
constitutes the indissoluble union of two beings that
associate to help each other and promote
happiness of each other in all aspects.
Someone may smile when hearing such a definition,
saying: "This is very nice in theory, on this day
partying..., but let the couple enter real life
and you will see that there is not as much happiness as today
they imagine. When such a union is not converted into a
hell! The distance between the "Moon of
honey” and the “Helmoon!” Why must it be like this?
God instituted marriage as a "thing
good", pleasant, beneficial, especially for the
man…; not so much for the woman, for whom it is
better, in some cases, not to get married... Nor is it
as indispensable as man; but in the
lucky marriages, it's good for both.
111
We sincerely believe, as Christians, the affirmations of that optimistic hymn, which says:
Oh Lord, You who created man
And you made him a garden of delights,
Above all your thanks you gave him
The woman, as an ideal help!
You do not change, Lord; for the man
How fervently he seeks you and proclaims;
For the humble soul that loves you,
This world becomes an Eden.
What should we do to make it like this? let's take
A look at Eden: What were the conditions
What made our first parents happy?
Many things have been said about the myth of
Eden, since the theory of evolution was opened
step in scientific circles. But what can't
denying science is that there is a tremendous leap between
the most evolved monkey and the conscious man
of himself, creator of ideas, gifted with speech;
spirit in a clay case – as someone has done
called–. And this justifies, and demands, a direct and special intervention of the Creator at the beginning of the
human race…
It is a notorious fact that the Eden tradition
It is found in the historical background of all peoples
and religions of the earth. Why can't we believe
that the Invisible One who manifests himself in his works (Romans 1:20), became visible through theophany and accomplished,
112
by direct intervention, in the earthly Paradise,
the great leap that anthropology cannot explain?
It is quite logical and plausible that this being, man, of
category so superior to animals, was placed
in a kind of natural museum where I could
learn to know the world that was to be
given lordship with his superior intelligence.
And this historical fact, accredited by the Holy Scriptures and by the traditions or memories most
or less vague of all humanity, leads us to
ask ourselves: What were the conditions that
Did they make our first parents happy there? They
then, without a doubt, many good things were missing
that art and industry have given us in
the material order. Taking advantage of such advantages that
offers us the experience of humanity, we could be much happier than them, and it
we would be if we knew how to comply with the moral
and spiritual that they possessed and practiced. Which
are these?
1. The characteristics of Eden
1) Mutual identity.
“A helpmeet,” says the biblical text. Adam observed that all animals had their mate, but
He was alone... God left man, destined
to be crown of creation, lonely for a little while
time for him to realize his need.
A female of the animal world, the best of the breed
113
of the apes, could not satisfy him... There would be no
there was no identification or possible communion with a
being of such a different nature, without spirituality;
without speech, without taste or capacity for art, and
beauty; without higher intelligence. That is why the Creator
intervened again forming the true crown
of creation, which is at the same time of man: woman.A being that completed the man and met his physical and moral needs. With it the man
felt happy and grateful; He saw that God had given him
exactly what suited him.
2) A sincere and unique love.
For Adam there was literally and effectively no other
woman on earth than Eve; for this he loved her with
all the passion of his soul. According to the poet Milton, it was
Her love was so great that she faced the danger of disobeying God when she had disobeyed,
so as not to be separated from her. He wanted to run his
luck! Very poetic, but very possible!
3) Absence of sin.
There are those who mock sin (Proverbs
14:9). The Bible calls them fools. Those say it is
an idea invented by the authors of religions,
used by priests and pastors to scare people.
"Do what you want, as long as you don't run into the
human justice –they affirm–; don't have the rest
fear, for who can establish the limits of sin? But sin is a reality, because
114
Author of the Universe is a moral being, he cannot be a
be without intelligence or will. «He who made the eye,
"Won't he see?" says Psalm 139. For this reason, some things
They seem good to you and others bad. Sin is disobedience to the will of God, it is putting our will before our conscience and his commands. In the
Eden had not sinned, God instructed the first
couple, and both said "yes" and "amen"; they didn't feel
nothing bad, they didn't see anything bad around them, no
They could not doubt each other, nor God, they had the
perfect charity that thinks no evil. Lastly
place:
4) They enjoyed full communion with God.
Our first parents were not entirely alone; They had an audible and visible companion,
by Theophany... A manifestation of the Infinite is
He appeared daily to instruct them. If he was happy
man, in his solitude, through communion with
God, it was a thousand times more so when so extraordinary
privilege he was able to enjoy in the company of Eva. «Have you
heard, beloved – I would say – how He prepared all the
things for our well-being? It made it grow
grass and the juicy fruits of the trees for our refreshment, and this river that is divided into four
branches, and the birds that cheer us with their songs…
He says he loves us, and it's true; every flower, every bird,
Every tasty fruit I discover shows it to us.
And tomorrow we will hear his voice again, he will give us news
instructions. If you don't remember something, it will be
115
I will remember. How I would like to get to tomorrow
the afternoon!"
This is how our first parents lived and were happy, because:
a) They understood each other.
b) They loved each other.
c) They had no sin.
d) They enjoyed communion with God together.
But Paradise was lost. The enemy introduced
doubt, disobedience, and they had to be exiled. Happiness disappeared, but not desire.
We all want to be happy. Hence the beautiful phrase
poetic that "since because of the woman the
Paradise, every woman must strive to convert
in paradise his home.
2. The characteristics of Eden in the world
modern
But for this to be the case, the moral conditions of Paradise must be met. Not just the materials,
because the world is different; but if we achieve
practice the moral virtues that in that happy
once they happened, we can make our life better
looks like Paradise.
1) Get suitable help.
That the companion with whom one joins
look like yourself. We say to young people: No
116
go find a very cultured woman if you are a simple laborer; nor of high position, if you are poor; well
Even if you found it, there would be no suitability, but
a barrier between the two. You need a companion
that understands the things that you understand and can
help you with your advice. You don't need to have
exactly the same intellectual level that you have,
but at least he can understand you and identify with you and your things.
2) Unique and true love.
The reasoned, cold adaptation that includes therights of the other, would not, however, provide true happiness without the adherent of love. love
It facilitates adaptation, it ensures it. I am not referring to the
sexual attraction… this is not love (every man
can feel sexual attraction to women he doesn't like
love), but to tenderness, sympathy, admiration and
gratitude that inspires the partner
with his affection, his love, his attention, his actions
selfless This is why it is said of love: «More than yesterday,
but less than tomorrow. This, however, is not absolutely achievable without the third condition.
3) Absence of sin.
Someone will say: Is this condition possible? Yes all
We have the natural tendency to sin: we are selfish, willful, suspicious, and we are in a world
bad True, but there is a class of people, the
true Christians, of whom Jesus said: "No
They are of the world just as I am not of the world.
117
They are those who have broken with sin and have
the grace of God to help them overcome. No
We are in Paradise, it is true; But Jesus said: "He
Kingdom of God is among you. Christ came to
establish the Kingdom of God, the new Paradise in the
hearts for conversion (explain it to the new
listeners in brief). We have millions of examples of broken homes and waste by the
sin that were transformed by this phenomenon
spiritual.
Have you broken with sin? Have you been born of
new? There are millions of pseudo-Christians, not only
in the Catholic world, but also in the Protestant world,
totally deceived, thinking that regeneration was wrought by baptism. Are you, friends in attendance, Christians in name?
4) Communion with God.
This is the main secret of happiness in
homes and in the community. There are those who think
which is only a matter of friars and nuns, but it is not
like this. God is a living reality, an immanent Being in
the Universe that wants to have spiritual communion
with humans made in his image. We don't know
appears in Theophany, as in Eden, but it has
Given His Word, we can talk to Him, thank Him, consult Him about things and live in His presence. No
We cannot remove the bad things from the world, nor the
sinful tendency of our hearts, but,
believe it, through conversion, we can put God in
118
our lives... Christ wants to join the beings
humans that he has redeemed, in such an intimate way,
who calls them "his wife," and has promised to take us
to a bridal home that is preparing up there
(Revelation 3:20 and John 14:1). Some call us
fans to those of us who want to have this communion
with God..., they think you can be a Christian,
Catholic or Evangelical, without taking things so lightly.
fanaticism; going to church three or four times a
year, and such people claim to go to heaven. If there is a
heaven, they say, they don't want God to leave them out...
This is as senseless as if this wife intended
to be the wife of the young man in front of her, living
separated from him just by seeing him for a little while, two or three
times a year. However, this is what they intend
many called Christians with their heavenly Husband.
How can they hope to be happy here and there; in this
life and in the future?
Happiness, then, does not consist of external things... The Paradise of our first parents was not
paradise; when, because of sin, he began to
lack communion with God, and the most sumptuous home, full of rich tapestries and rugs, is sometimes a
hell for those who do not have the love of God in
their hearts. A hell of jealousy and misgivings, of
envy and resentment... And in such cases, without any
hope for the afterlife of death that we know will come to break and take away all our
goods and privileges of life.
119
5) Eternal love.
For this reason I would like to draw your attention to a
phrase that is repeated profusely in every courtship,
but that is rarely fulfilled: Eternal honeymoon.
The idea is correct, since it is true that there is no true happiness if it is not eternal. Just thinkingthat ends a good thing is a setback and
a torment (example of a vacation, a trip
pleasant, a party, etc.). In marriage we use
this phrase knowing in advance that it is a hyperbole, that it cannot be fulfilled. This supreme condition of happiness was a fact in our first parents before sin. They knew their luck
was different from that of animals, since they had
received with his superior intelligence a promise
of immortality. "The day you sin, you will die."
Then it occurred to you – God came to tell them – that being of a superior race, similar to the angels
who cannot die, you will be like beasts;
you will cease to be immortal.
And this supreme, most happy condition is also fulfilled in us, Christians. Not so
corporal; hence we have in our liturgies the
well-known phrase: "Until God separates you with
death", which sounds like a funeral bell,
like a drop of wormwood in the syrup of our
happiness on this day. But even when we can't
avoid the reality of death, there is hope for
the true Christians. Jesus said, “I am the resurrection and the life.”…He came “to take away death, and
120
to bring life and immortality to light, through the Gospel. For this reason we can make the phrase "Eternal honeymoon" our own, because even when the honeymoon is over
small amount of honey from the glass in our lives,
we have the inexhaustible torrent of happiness that Christ
He has promised us in the higher life. There you will meet and unite our beloved wives and husbands
(because love never ceases to be). We will find them,
not for a physical union (which we will not need either), but for a moral and spiritual union, remembering the life we spent together and looking at the
much happier than we will have in front of us.
This is what we wish and wish, not only for our beloved brothers X and
also to all of you who have come to witness
their union before God, sharing their joy in this
memorable day. I hope it is a memorable day, no
only for them, but for those who today could
understand the happiness of the Christian life, giving
to Christ their hearts will begin to truly live and experience it.
121

content:
MEANING OF LOVE
(Ephesians 5:25-28;
1 Corinthians 13:4-8)
The wedding of our beloved "X" and "X" gives us
an excellent opportunity to talk about the old topic
of love.1
It has been said that love is art, poetry, music
of the soul. It is the means chosen by the Creator to
the basic institution of human society: the family, and for the preservation of races. love is,
indeed, the vehicle of life.
Because it is something so great, so sublime, love is
also the most falsified virtue. You know well that in
The material terrain is not subject to falsification.
vulgar things, but always the most precious, the
of more value, works of art, jewelry...
In the moral field, love is the divine treasure
that most efforts have been made to falsify.
Love is falsified and debased in brothels;
it is faked in courtships of convenience; is imitated and
devalues in bad marriages…
For this, my beloved, at this solemn and sacred moment of your lives, when you come to
122
unite them before God by the holy bond of marriage, I consider it appropriate to give you, in the light of the
Divine word, a concise and exact idea of true love, so that you wonder in the depths of
your consciences if it is and if it will be of that legitimate
quality, the love that you profess and that has brought you
to this place.
1. Analysis of love
How light is broken down into seven colors
pass through a prism and all together they form
the wonderful gift of God that allows us to enjoy
of the privilege of vision, thus love, analyzed by
the powerful and inspired intellect of the apostle Paul,
is decomposed, to show us some of its
characteristics in a well-defined way.
1) True love is selfless.
With two great phrases the apostle Paul defines
this feature. It says: love "is suffered", "it is not
"Seek what is yours." While false love is selfish and
seeks only its own good, its own satisfaction,
pretending to love the other, true love is
altruistic, seeks the good of others, is compassionate. If
says: "It doesn't matter if I suffer a little more, as long as
that the other being whom I love suffers a little less,
have less discomfort, benefit or recreation. I
I enjoy myself, seeing how he – or she – enjoys himself. I have
in that my compensation.
123
When that love is mutual, a relationship is established
kind of rivalry in their practice. How many times
Older people remember having to say to our faithful companions: "If you don't eat this, I won't eat it."
like", "if you don't go, I won't go..." Hence the expression
proverb: "Partirse un piñon", which means sharing even the smallest things; all things
good, in the same way that the eventualities of
Life forces us to share the bad things.
2) He is patient.
"He hopes all things, endures all things..." The bond of
Marriage means the union of two wills
different, diverse. How to combine them? How to put them in concert?
How do you assemble two pieces of wood? Cutting half the thickness of a rope from both
half of the other. Thus, once assembled, they appear
a single smooth piece. In the same way you must sacrifice, wife, a part of your will to make room for
to that of your spouse. Another day, if he is understanding,
He will sacrifice a part of his will to please you.
You must bear in mind that neither of the two
He is a perfect being. Wife, your husband will have his
mistakes, his obstinacy, his tastes. don't try
make them understand or change their mind
based on your stubbornness. Be patient, wait;
The time will come to make them reflect when
the setback has passed.
124
Husband, your wife is not an angel, although such
You may have told him more than once. It is not a being
perfect, it will have failures, errors, delays, which perhaps
They will thwart your plans; He also has a will
own that you must respect, it is not a machine or a
slave When she has failed, it is your duty to repair the failure, not with harsh rebukes, which would be
like drops of wormwood in the honey of love that youyou profess, but with your activity, with your example. Yes
She is late in something, help her. The same
Seeing you willing to help her, it will be to her
of more encouragement than the harshest words, because
The Spanish woman has a certain pride in the profession "her work." And do it with a smiling face,
even joking, so that I don't take your bad side
entry into their chores.
Maintaining the idyll of courtship is the true
secret of your happiness. Would you break it for something stupid? For some delay? For carelessness? True love is patient, it does not get irritated, it does not
holds a grudge
3) He is confident.
«Love believes everything, hopes everything, everything
supports."
–But this is being candid –some will say–. The
love is suspicious, always distrustful, jealous; the
Jealousy is proof of love.
No, this is a big mistake; not jealousy
They are proof of love, but of selfishness. Will you want to
125
you alone all the smiles of your angel? If so,
It would be that you don't love her as much as you pretend. let it
others admire what you possess, may they envy your
happiness, may they congratulate you in their hearts… And so that
so be it, you must allow your wife to alternate with
other men, honestly, within the terms of the purity and love of God, which you know are
of your beloved, his greatest spiritual treasure. Jealousy
do not fit among high-quality believers because in
There is no room for sin in their lives.
And you, wife, should you be suspicious of what may
make your husband out of your sight?
Jealousy, instead of being one of the qualities
of love, they are a disease of love, a torment of the soul. Allow me to give you two pieces of advice, two effective remedies against the evil of possible infidelity that upsets the entire world and is the origin
of all kinds of ill will, altercations and even
of crimes.
a) The first remedy is to treat your husband in such a way
way when he is with you, at home or away,
May I not find another happiness absent from you; treat it like
a boyfriend for life...
b) The second remedy is to encourage in your soul
true piety, the fear of God, a more faith
and deeper. If your husband lives close to God, yes
He feels at every moment before his holy presence,
if you have not neglected the reading of the divine Word
and other deeply Christian books that elevate your thoughts and exalt your ideals, difficult126
mind may be carried away by the temptations of the
sin. The Christian thought of "You, Lord,
"You see," will keep him from all temptation, because he knows that
Although he could fool you, he cannot fool
God.
My beloved, you have the privilege that your
love is founded on the rock of your faith. Yes
you both believe with all your heart, if you know that you are not
yours, but you both belong to Christ, your divine Redeemer and Lord, you will not feel free
to do whatever you want, to follow the
impulses of the old man; nor in the small details of life, nor to miss the solemn
promise of mutual fidelity that at this moment
you are going to do…
4) It is permanent.
Then your love will take over, and
as a corollary of all the other virtues that the
apostle highlights, the final virtue, the most decisive, the
absolute, the virtue of permanence. "Love never
stop being…”
2. The highest example of true love
Hence the same apostle who in 1 Corinthians
13 gives us such a complete description and analysis of the
love in general, in the second passage it says, as
example of conjugal love, the highest and perfect
of loves: the love of Christ for the Church.
127
See the similarity: The love of Christ was and is
disinterested, because he needed and needs nothing
us; He is long-suffering and benign, since it cost him the sufferings of the cross to be able to redeem us; did not look for his
own good, but ours, to make ourselves happy with Him
for eternity. His love is also patient, because
He supports us when we are not for Him what we should be, His love is firm and eternal. never stops
be.
This is why the love of Christ is the love that deservesbe held as a motto and teaching of our lives,
as a model of our own human love, yeah
we want to enjoy the relative happiness that we
It is possible to reach on earth. And above all, friends, and this is the most important thing, the love of Christ,
Faith in Christ, belonging to Christ, is the guide and guarantee of that other absolute and perfect happiness.
to which our souls aspire: the happiness that has not
to have an end.
Many have wondered: Why in such a human passage, which begins with "Husbands, love
to your wives", the apostle Paul mixes a theme
so different, so spiritual, like that of the love of
Christ for the Church?
Do you know why? Because in addition to the curious
similarities that we have pointed out, the love of Christ
It is the most important, the definitive, the eternal; everything
The rest, the good and the bad, is transitory, fleeting,
despicable and does not perfectly fill the needs of our soul which, because it is made
128
image and likeness of God enjoys, yes, the fleeting, but with nostalgia for the eternal; feeling that
This, here, is not the definitive thing.
When we see you in this place, my beloved, in
this day of celebration, of rejoicing, on "your day", without
doubt the happiest of your life, we remember our own day. It seems like yesterday that we were full of
illusions, plans, projects, in front of another
servant of God who spoke to us in the same
terms; sitting like you at the door of the
life, promising us a happiness that we have
enjoyed for almost half a century in the presence of
God in the midst of the vicissitudes of life. But they have
Years have passed and we are already in the twilight. Yes everything
ended here, what a small thing it would be, we tell ourselves, the
human existence!
But with this reference to the love of Christ to
Church, to believers who have accepted their
love, and to Him they have been united by the ties of faith, God
He tells us: Sursum corda (up with the hearts); there is
another permanent, eternal happiness for Christians.
For those of us who have a heavenly husband who ascended to heaven, there is a better hope, above
and beyond all the fleeting happiness of the
life.
Yes, friends, the Word of God assures us that
there is a spiritual wedding for our glorified beings, a glorious feast day that He has promised us; a wedding in which all, dear friends,
you are invited. And we would like you to invite her129
tion that has led you to witness the wedding of
our beloved “X” and “X” will also take you to
that heavenly wedding. That would induce you to think about
how good and necessary it is to be a true Christian.
May it bring you to receive Christ in your heart, and to
live under the protection of his grace, free from many dangers that destroy the happiness of so many families,
free from sin, free from the fear of death, walking with hope, until, leaning on
your companions in life, have
May God call you to enjoy that other definitive and eternal existence, saved by Christ.
May God bless our beloved brothers in their new state, making them a marriage
exemplary Christian.
May God make your home a haven of
peace, love, true and lasting love.
May God bless his children if he pleases
grant them, may the Lord grant them prosperity
and health.
And that when many years from now you look
remembering this day, you can give thanks to God
for having made you find each other. By
have allowed you to support and help each other; both united to the Lord, both in the easy and pleasant moments and in the moments
difficult things in your life. And without having warmed
your love an iota, but on the contrary, loving each other
more and better for the favors and services that you will have
had occasion to dispense to each other in
130
multiple circumstances of your earthly career,
prepare to enter the definitive happiness of
Kingdom of Heaven, where, without physical love existing,The union of love with those remains, however.
that we have loved on earth, because "love
"It never ceases to be."
131

content:
ISAAC'S WIFE,
CHURCH FIGURE
(Genesis 24:34-38;
Ephesians 5:22)
Abraham was the man chosen to be a father
of the Jewish people, chosen by God to bring his revelation to the world. For this reason he took him away from his relatives
idolatrous For the divine promise to be fulfilled,
I needed to marry Isaac, and I had to do it with a
idolatrous girl of the land, a stranger who would distance her son from the ideals of the patriarchal clan, founded on the promises of God. For this reason he took an oath to Eliezer, because there was danger that without this
formality will neglect his assignment given the difficulties of the company. The following are worth noting
details:
a) The danger of going with a small caravan
the desert
b) The difficulty of finding and persuading the
girl
c) The risk that once found and brought
to the patriarchal camp was not pleasing to the son,
or perhaps the father.
132
Not only Abraham was pious in that great
house. His servants knew God as the Omnipresent, Omniscient and Omnipotent. They had had proof of this in the case of Hagar and in the destruction of Sodom. This is why Eliezer knows how to resort
opportunely to the occasion, and shows a skillful
emissary of the great patriarch.
Tell the story briefly, noting what
what follows:
a) How well it presents the heir. Emphasize that
It is rich and unique.
b) The urgency of the case, which makes him give up
a well-deserved rest and wait at home
Laban.
c) The intrepid decision of the girl in her
adventure of faith
d) Isaac's mercy. What would you order in the
well of the "Living One who sees me", that is, the miraculous fountain of Hagar? Surely, the good success of
messenger who was going for such an important matter
his life.
e) The humility of the girl, shown in a
curious eastern custom (v. 65). The whole story is
a beautiful example for young people. we can
believe that it was not only in Isaac's marriage that
God, but if "the eyes of the Lord are upon the
righteous", and it is true what the Lord assures us in
Matthew 6:26-34, a
matter as important as each person's marriage
one of his children. Marriage that is beginning,
133
concerted and carried out in prayer, it cannot but
that will be a success.
Let us notice that Isaac did not rush. He was 40 years old;
He did not look at the physical beauty of the bride, since neither
I knew her. He thought only of his responsibility as
"son of the promise." Every marriage is one thing
very serious, because it involves the formation of a home
to get through life; which is both a test or
exam for eternity.
This story is not to be considered only
as an instructive example of human marriage, since certain details that occur in it
